scope: exploratory fixed OAS and ML denominator control on the existing full matrix
test_notice: The previous test results are already known. This round cannot establish untouched-test validation or select hyperparameters on Test.

score_definitions.top1p: float64 mean of highest floor(0.01*65536)=655 saved raw pixels

covariance: S=(n-1)/n*C, where C is the existing unbiased normal-training covariance; ML control S+0.01I; OAS (1-alpha)S+alpha trace(S)/D I+0.01I
oas_alpha: per position sklearn1.6.1 OAS formula from normal train only; not a global median, not Test-tuned
geometry: original RGB bilinear224 ImageNet ResNet18/layer1,2,3 100 frozen channels; distance56 bilinear224 Gaussian sigma4 bilinear256; no per-image map normalization; GT nearest256
metrics: same exact quick_metrics.evaluate_from_files; all pixels; equal-region AUPRO@0.30 8-connectivity; image score separately declared per row
selection: the original mechanically selected first normal and first anomaly per category, including regressions

sources.title: scikit-learn OAS implementation
sources.role: established covariance estimator; integration is not an originality claim
